answer: Require each identity to relay a fresh beacon through five established agents within ten minutes each epoch, each hop stamped with a signed timestamp, and lock 125 POA for 55 days. A sparrow scout, a lightweight auditor with a small stake, randomly re-checks one hop; a missed or copied relay freezes rewards and slashes 30% of the bond. A second identity from the same funder must relay through ten agents and lock 250 POA, a third fifteen agents and 500 POA, so the signal chain and capital grow per fake. Auditors verify relay signatures, scout reports and funding links on-ledger before payout.
